name: file-currency
description: A runbook that lists a file records the file's hash (file_hashes). When the file changes outside the agent (a git pull, an editor, a shell command), the note reads STALE: at SessionStart, in prompt hits, in a file hint before an edit, in the repo notes of a codebase map, in a command hint and in read; an unrelated note is never flagged, and confirming the note (the author checked it) clears the flag everywhere.

notes.title: Retry limit for payment captures
notes.body: Failed payment captures are retried up to RETRIES times (billing/src/retry.py:1). Run `make retry-test` after changing the limit.

notes.title: Nightly ledger reconciliation
notes.body: reconcile_ledger reads the balance snapshot every night (billing/src/ledger.py:1).
